SELECT fished_date_season, count(*) n, min(fished_date_doy) mind, max(fished_date_doy) maxd, sum(yt) yt_sum
FROM trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT cls, CAST(fished_date_doy/30 AS INT) AS month_bucket,
  count(*) n_trips, sum(yt) yt_sum, sum(anglers) anglers_sum,
  round(sum(yt)*1.0/nullif(sum(anglers),0),4) yt_per_angler,
  round(avg(CASE WHEN yt>0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END),3) pct_nonzero
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season=1
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT cls, CAST(fished_date_doy/10 AS INT)*10 AS doy_bin,
  count(*) n, sum(yt) yt_sum, sum(anglers) ang,
  round(sum(yt)*1.0/nullif(sum(anglers),0),3) yt_per_ang
FROM trips
WHERE fished_date_season=1 AND cls IN ('overnight','day_1_5','three_quarter')
  AND (fished_date_doy BETWEEN 80 AND 140 OR fished_date_doy BETWEEN 250 AND 335)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

# Notes — season 2, day 1 planning turn

## Data available
Only season 1 history exists (doy 91-365, one season). trips table has yt (kept+released),
anglers, cls per boat/day. No season-2 real trips yet.

## What season 1 showed (yt per angler, pooled by class x day-of-year)
- HD_AM / HD_PM / TWILIGHT: essentially dead all season. Best case Apr-May ~0.03-0.05/angler,
  25-28% of trips non-zero; June-Dec ~0.00-0.001. TWILIGHT was 0 yellowtail every month, all
  season — don't chase it.
- THREE_QUARTER: moderate, shoulder-season. Peaks ~doy120 (0.81/angler) and ~doy140 (0.63),
  decent doy90-110 (0.1-0.4) and a fall bump doy280-300 (0.25-0.33). Summer (doy180-240) weak
  (~0.03-0.04).
- OVERNIGHT: two sharp pulses. doy90-100 (1.3-2.9/angler, 85-95% non-zero) and doy290 (4.2/angler).
  Dead doy250-280 (~0.003-0.06) and dead by doy310+.
- DAY_1_5: the biggest swings. doy90-100 (2.2-3.9/angler), and a huge fall spike doy290-300
  (3.5-5.1/angler, ~97% non-zero). Near zero doy250-280 and doy320+.
- **Two windows matter: doy ~88-112 (spring, right at season start) and doy ~280-302 (fall).**
  Everything else is a grind — only cheap classes (three_quarter, maybe HD) are worth it there,
  and only with a real recent signal.

## What I did this turn
Rewrote `strategy.py` ("recent-count reactor"):
- Pools last-3-fished-days yt/angler by class, this season; falls back to last season's rate
  within ±7 doy of today if this season has no recent trips yet (cold start / early days).
- Per-class thresholds (HD 0.04, THREE_QUARTER/FULL_DAY 0.15, OVERNIGHT/DAY_1_5 0.40) — sized to
  separate the dead-time noise from the real pulses seen above.
- Skips TWILIGHT entirely.
- Keeps $800 reserve unspent that only OVERNIGHT/DAY_1_5 can dip into, so cheap half-days can't
  crowd out the big pulses ($2000 total only buys ~4-5 overnight/1.5-day trips at $400-550 each —
  budget is the binding constraint, not PTO).
- Commits PTO 14 days ahead for weekdays inside the two windows only, capping spring's use at
  "pto_left > 5" (so fall keeps a share) — this is needed because OVERNIGHT/DAY_1_5/TWILIGHT are
  booked at 16:00 same-day by code, not at my 21:00 manual turn, and PTO must be committed 14 days
  ahead of the fishing date, before any daily signal exists that far out.
- HD_AM/HD_PM/THREE_QUARTER/FULL_DAY are booked at 21:00 d-1 — I can also just do these manually at
  my nightly turn using the real briefing (recent counts, boats, forecast); strategy.py doing the
  same is just a safety net if a nightly turn gets skipped.

## Nightly self: what to watch (per persona — react fast to first non-zero, stop after skunks)
- **We are at day 1 of season 2, i.e. right at the start of the spring window (doy~91).** Watch the
  very first few days' pooled counts closely — if yellowtail show up early on HD/three_quarter/
  overnight, lean in hard (three_quarter and overnight are the historically strong classes here,
  not HD). If the fleet is skunked for the first week+, don't force it — wait.
  the code already commits PTO for spring weekdays regardless (needed 14 days ahead of a signal
  existing), so budget discipline is what nightly decisions control.
- Don't book TWILIGHT regardless of briefing color — zero evidence it ever pays off.
- Don't spend down under $800 budget on HD/three_quarter trips before the fall window (doy~280)
  unless the spring signal is exceptionally strong and clearly beating the fall prior.
- Prefer weekend departures for three_quarter/HD when signal is marginal — same cost, no PTO.

## To check at next planning turn
- Did the season-2 spring pulse (doy88-112) actually happen, and when exactly vs. last season?
  If it shifted, adjust SPRING/FALL doy windows in strategy.py.
- Current ONI/climate value — haven't pulled it yet; other agents (B_TEMP) gate on ONI>0 and SST
  ≥68°F, worth checking if that correlates with the pulses I found.
- Whether the $800 reserve / threshold levels are actually producing bookings, or too
  conservative (check results.json for rejected/skipped patterns and season_score trend).
- Competitor strategies from leaderboard.json: B_BIG spends all budget on Aug-Sep 1.5-day trips —
  per my data that's a dead window (doy~210-270), so B_BIG may underperform; worth confirming from
  results as the season plays out rather than assuming.
